<?php
// E2E probe (test only): switches Google Pay on or off, and the optional Google Pay options filter on or off, between page loads.
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'set' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
	if ( isset( $_GET['gp'] ) ) { $s['enable_google_pay'] = 'yes' === $_GET['gp'] ? 'yes' : 'no'; update_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', $s ); }
	if ( isset( $_GET['env'] ) ) { update_option( 'cz_e2e_gp_env', '1' === $_GET['env'] ? '1' : '0' ); }
	echo wp_json_encode( array( 'gp' => $s['enable_google_pay'] ?? null, 'env' => get_option( 'cz_e2e_gp_env', '0' ) ) );
	exit;
} );
// The documented way to pass an extra Google Pay option, if the gateway ever says it is needed (ASSUMPTION GP1).
add_filter( 'cardz3n_gw_google_pay_options', function ( $o, $test_mode ) {
	if ( '1' === get_option( 'cz_e2e_gp_env', '0' ) ) { $o['environment'] = $test_mode ? 'TEST' : 'PRODUCTION'; $o['bad'] = array( 'not', 'scalar' ); }
	return $o;
}, 10, 2 );
